source.title: Virginia Indians: Virginia State Recognized Tribes
source.source_edition: Unversioned web table observed October 14, 2026. No record-level effective date established.

as_of_scope: Actual observation date, not a new effective date for state or federal recognition.
scope_note: Eleven name rows in the Virginia Secretary of the Commonwealth state-recognized table. This is an attributed state directory snapshot, not all Indigenous peoples or communities of Virginia. Some rows also appear in the separate federal directory; catalogue units are not added as distinct Nations.
extraction_note: Read one table headed Tribe, Year Recognized and Location. Eleven distinct source labels independently matched with a second HTML-cell extraction. Seven asterisks are preserved in directory_name and source_federal_marker; name removes only the trailing notation marker. State website links were read in source order; only four own homepages were fetched and reviewed as identity links. No personal contacts are copied.
public_extraction_note: Names follow Virginia's published table. The source marks seven rows with an asterisk for both federal and state recognition; identity matches and histories remain separate research work.
public_notes: A state list is a planning source, not the definition of who is Indigenous. Unlisted communities, peoples and distinct governing bodies need their own sources.
State and federal lists overlap. These eleven rows are not eleven additional Nations and are never added to other lists as a unique total.
The snapshot date records when the pages were read. The table's recognition years remain source metadata and are not assigned as current record-level effective dates.

checks.independent_extraction: BeautifulSoup table cells exactly match a separate regex row/cell extraction.

review.identity: Four specific directory-to-profile links reviewed by ZOTHEOS; remaining rows unreviewed.

followup.scope: Review each Nation's own preferred name, governing-body scope and public history before canonical profile creation or identity linking. Track Virginia communities outside the state list separately with their own evidence.
